name: BREACH — Princess chapters polish
scope: Nine princess chapters in story order behind a key-art home page and chapter map: The Vault, Frost Warden, Mooncoil Reliquary, Bellforge Run, Tidewheel Citadel, Gatehouse Siege, Lumi Breaks Out, Serpent Rivals, Dragon’s Hoard. Ball-control tutorial, a purpose card per chapter, villain clocks that end in losing Lumi, themed special bricks, stronger power-ups, a bigger ball, full-screen scenes, the M365 yeti with its dash and the fire serpent. Space chapters are hidden from the menu (save slots kept).
limitations: Debug preview; ads and purchases are local simulations. Physical-phone performance and human difficulty require device testing.
